name: Number Slide
author: Giovana Ferreira Waterkemper, Jamily Go
description: The classic 15-puzzle: slide the numbered tiles into the empty space until they are all in ascending order. Arrows to move the tiles, X to start.

descriptions.en: The classic 15-puzzle: slide the numbered tiles into the empty space until they are all in ascending order. Arrows to move the tiles, X to start.
descriptions.it: Il classico gioco del 15: fai scorrere le tessere numerate nello spazio vuoto finché non sono tutte in ordine crescente. Frecce per spostarle, X per iniziare.
